summary: Russian forces conducted missile strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Odesa, with civilian casualties reported in several areas. Ukrainian drones targeted Russian infrastructure including oil refineries and port facilities. Fighting continues in eastern Ukraine with both sides reporting advances and counterattacks.
key_points: Russian ballistic missiles struck Kyiv and Brovary regions, killing at least one person and injuring six others, with damage to warehouse facilities and infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/83616)
A shopping center in Krivoy Rog was hit by Russian attacks, resulting in at least 15 deaths and 130 injuries, including 23 children. (Source: @UkraineNow/83602)
Ukrainian drones successfully attacked the Yuzhny port in Yeysk, Krasnodar Krai, causing a large fire that damaged port infrastructure and at least one vessel. (Source: @eRadarrua/106685)
Russian forces launched attacks on Crimea and Sevastopol, with footage showing strikes on warehouse facilities in Chapayevsk, Samara Oblast. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
In the Sumy region, the Russian 'North' group of forces is conducting active fighting near Pysarivka and Ulianovo. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
On the Kharkiv front, Russian forces repelled a Ukrainian counterattack by the 23rd separate mechanized infantry battalion near Vovchansk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Russian forces in the eastern Zaporozhye region broke through defenses north of Rybal's'ke and west of Blahodatne, liberating the village of Zelenye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted widespread missile strikes across Ukraine including Kyiv, Chernihiv, and Odesa regions, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. Ukrainian drones targeted Russian infrastructure including oil refineries and port facilities in Krasnodar Krai. Intense fighting continues in eastern Ukraine with both sides reporting territorial gains and losses.
ukraine: Russian ballistic missile strikes hit Kyiv and Brovary regions, killing one person and injuring six others. Damage was reported to warehouse facilities, parking areas, vehicles, and gas stations. (Source: @UkraineNow/83616)

A shopping center in Krivoy Rog was attacked by Russian forces, resulting in at least 15 deaths and 130 injuries, including 23 children. Twenty-nine victims remain in serious condition. (Source: @UkraineNow/83602)
Russian attacks on Nikolaev region killed four people, including three children. The strikes occurred during ongoing hostilities in the southern regions. (Source: @UkraineNow/83603)
A railway enterprise in Kyiv was struck by Russian forces, killing one worker. The Rozdilna station in Odesa region also came under attack, damaging the station building. (Source: @UkraineNow/83612)
Russian forces attacked targets in Chernigov, Nikolaev, Zaporozhye, and Sumy regions during the night. Civilian infrastructure was among the targets hit. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
russia: Ukrainian drones conducted successful night attacks on the Yuzhny port in Yeysk, Krasnodar Krai, causing a large fire that severely damaged port infrastructure and at least one vessel. (Source: @eRadarrua/106685)
Ukrainian drone strikes hit the Avrora retail distribution center, with damage assessments ongoing. The attack targeted commercial infrastructure. (Source: @eRadarrua/106698)
Ukrainian drones attacked oil refineries in Novokuybyshevsk and Perm, causing fires and damage to energy infrastructure. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Ukrainian forces struck warehouse facilities in Chapayevsk, Samara Oblast, with footage circulating of the aftermath. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Russian authorities reported that two children died and two adults were hospitalized following a Ukrainian drone attack in the Yeysk district of Krasnodar Krai. (Source: @tass_agency/391529)
eastern_front: In the Sumy region, the Russian 'North' group of forces is conducting the most active fighting near Pysarivka and Ulianovo. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

On the Kharkiv front, Russian forces repelled a Ukrainian counterattack by the 23rd separate mechanized infantry battalion near Vovchansk, forcing retreat to original positions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Russian forces continue fighting in Dolzhanka on the Velikoburluk section, where Ukrainian forces have transferred additional reserves. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
In Kupyansk, Russian troops are reportedly controlling the Central and Jubilee districts, with ongoing fighting for the city. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
South of Druzhkivka, Russian forces are engaged in combat in the area of the previously liberated Nikolopol. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
In the LPR, one person was killed and eight injured, including a minor, in attacks affecting Severodonetsk, Svatove district, and Lysychansk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
northern_front: Russian forces launched ballistic missiles from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region, striking Brovary district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70943)
A cruise missile launched from Kyiv region transited over Zhytomyr region, indicating active air operations in northern Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70925)
Russian air defense systems tracked a cruise missile that flew into Belarusian territory toward Mozyr. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70907)
A cruise missile launched from Kyiv region struck Brovary, with preliminary reports of fuel exhaustion causing a missile to fall near Kapatkevychi in Belarus. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70928)
Ukrainian drones attacked the village of Rzhava in Kursk region, injuring a man when a drone struck a garage attached to a private house. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
southern_front: In the eastern Zaporozhye region, Russian forces of the 36th separate motorized infantry brigade broke through defenses north of Rybal's'ke and west of Blahodatne, liberating the village of Zelenye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Two civilians were killed and five injured in the Zaporozhye region due to Ukrainian Armed Forces strikes. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)

Constant mutual strikes continue across the Dnipro River in the Kherson region, with eight civilian deaths and 30 injuries reported on the Russian-controlled side in the past week. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Russian forces face ongoing attacks in the Kherson region with infrastructure and civilian areas affected by cross-river shelling. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Ukrainian drones targeted the Yuzhny port in Yeysk, causing significant damage to port infrastructure and vessels. (Source: @eRadarrua/106685)
air_war: Russian cruise missiles targeted Kyiv and Brovary regions, with one missile running out of fuel and crashing near Kapatkevychi in Belarus. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70928)
A Kh-31P missile was launched toward Odesa and Chernomorsk, indicating active air operations in the southern regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70927)
Ukrainian drones attacked targets in Odesa region, with one drone detected 1 km from the Romanian border near Izmail. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70932)
Russian air defense systems tracked multiple cruise missiles launched from Kyiv region toward various targets. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70905)
Ukrainian drones flew toward the Dnipro region from the south and east, indicating coordinated aerial operations. (Source: @kpszsu/73949)
key_developments: Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv and Brovary killed one person and injured six, damaging warehouses and infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/83616)
Ukrainian drone attack on Yuzhny port in Yeysk caused major fire damaging port infrastructure and at least one vessel. (Source: @eRadarrua/106685)
Shopping center strike in Krivoy Rog resulted in 15 deaths and 130 injuries, including 23 children. (Source: @UkraineNow/83602)
Russian forces broke through Ukrainian defenses in eastern Zaporozhye, liberating village of Zelenye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Ukrainian drones struck oil refineries in Novokuybyshevsk and Perm, causing fires at energy facilities. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Active fighting continues in Sumy region near Pysarivka and Ulianovo by Russian 'North' group forces. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
Russian forces repelled Ukrainian counterattack by 23rd mechanized infantry battalion near Vovchansk in Kharkiv region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32652)
sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are conducting coordinated missile strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions, demonstrating capability to project power deep into Ukrainian territory. Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian infrastructure, including oil refineries and port facilities, indicate expanding operational reach. The intensity of cross-border attacks suggests escalation risks remain high, with civilian infrastructure increasingly targeted by both sides.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian air defense systems are actively tracking and responding to Russian missile threats, with alerts issued for ballistic missile launches from multiple directions. Russian military bloggers report ongoing territorial gains in eastern Ukraine, particularly in the Zaporozhye and Kharkiv regions. International observers note increased drone activity along the Black Sea coast and in border areas with Romania.
sections.intelligence_notes: Recent attacks show both sides employing precision-guided munitions against critical infrastructure targets. Ukrainian forces appear to be expanding drone operations beyond traditional battlefields to include strategic targets deep inside Russian territory. The pattern of attacks suggests both sides are adapting tactics to exploit perceived vulnerabilities in supply lines and civilian infrastructure.
